title: Three-Move Agreement
next_chapter_hook: In the night, a cold voice sounded beside Chen Ji's ear: 'I have a way to let you neither go to war nor stay in the Imperial Capital with proper reason.' Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, a meaningful smile playing on his lips.

text.content: Moonlight fell like frost upon the tranquil courtyard of the side hall. The masked figure slowly removed the final layer of concealment, revealing a face somewhat similar to Chen Ji's—sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, angular and resolute features, only with a few extra lines of time carved at the corners of the eyes. He called himself Chen Ming, Chen Tianming's junior brother.

dialogue.content: Chen Ming's voice was low and hoarse: 'Chen Ji, I have waited twenty years for this opportunity.' He paused, his gaze falling on the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve. 'You should know that every page of the Tianji Record involves heavenly fate and fortune. The few pages you hold have already attracted quite some attention.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression calm as usual, only a cold glint flickering in the depths of his eyes. Mo Xiansheng's warning quickly flashed through his mind—the aura of the Tianji Record would attract those with designs, yet he hadn't expected them to arrive so quickly. He calmly assessed the man before him who claimed to be Chen Ming, secretly calculating.

dialogue.content: 'I'm not here to be your enemy.' Chen Ming seemed to read Chen Ji's thoughts, his voice carrying a complex tone. 'On the contrary, I have a proposal, one that benefits us both.' He raised three fingers. 'Three conditions. After agreeing, I guarantee that during your time in the imperial court, no one will come to disturb you.'

text.content: 'First,' Chen Ming raised one finger, his voice cold and unquestionable. 'You must maintain absolute neutrality in the imperial succession struggle, and not secretly support any prince. Second, do not proactively contact Chen Tianming—wherever he is, whatever he is doing, you must not interfere.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ming raised his third finger, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'Third, and most importantly—temporarily hand over the fourth page of the Tianji Record to my keeping.' His voice slightly paused. 'Don't worry, I only need three months. After three months, I will return it to you unchanged.'

text.content: The courtyard fell into deathly silence. The autumn wind lifted several fallen leaves, swirling between the two. Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the flash of cold intent in his gaze. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'The fourth page is the core of the Tianji Record; once handed over, you will lose the ability to foresee events three hours in the future.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a faint smile curling his lips, his voice unusually calm: 'Senior Chen, I can consider the first two conditions.' He paused, then shifted gears. 'But the third condition, I must decline. The Tianji Record Fragments are my late master's legacy—every page is irreplaceable.'

text.content: Chen Ming's eyes instantly turned dangerous, spiritual pressure faintly radiating from his body. But Chen Ji remained nonchalant, as if unaware of the oppressive force. In his heart, he was calculating rapidly: If Chen Ming truly has connections to Chen Tianming, his understanding of the Tianji Record might far exceed his own.

dialogue.content: 'You are very cautious.' Chen Ming stared at Chen Ji for a long moment, then suddenly laughed, withdrawing his spiritual pressure. 'Very well, it's good for young people to be wary. Let's change the approach—you maintain neutrality in the imperial succession struggle and do not proactively contact Chen Tianming. In exchange, I will tell you some... things about Chen Tianming.'

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Ming's compromise and probing, Chen Ji needed to respond.

choices.text: Accept the conditions and extract intelligence first
choices.description: Agree to maintain neutrality on the surface while secretly continuing to strategize. Immediately inquire about Chen Tianming's whereabouts after agreeing.
choices.visible_cost: Lose leverage with the Crown Prince's trust
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence on Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ming may set an information trap

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, his voice calm: 'Deal. But I have one thing to say first—if Senior's intelligence is false, this agreement becomes void.' His gaze was like a blade, staring directly at Chen Ming. 'Now, please tell me, where is Chen Tianming now?'

dialogue.content: A glint of approval flashed in Chen Ming's eyes as he took out a jade slip from his sleeve: 'Chen Tianming appeared in the northern border city three days ago, seemingly investigating an ancient secret treasure. But more importantly—' he lowered his voice. 'He has a girl by his side, about fifteen or sixteen years old, named Chen Nian.'

choices.text: Continue negotiations while keeping cards close to chest
choices.description: Do not promise neutrality, only accept intelligence exchange. Probe Chen Ming's true understanding of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his voice still calm, but his words carried unwavering determination: "Neutrality can be discussed, but I never make promises without an escape route. If the elder truly wishes to cooperate, show some sincerity first—tell me Chen Tiaming's current situation."

dialogue.content: Chen Ming fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Excellent, excellent! You don't release the arrow until you see the hare! Truly a disciple of Chen Xuan." He took out a Jade Slip from his breast pocket. "Chen Tiaming appeared in the Northern Frontier three days ago, and he has with him your sister who has been missing for many years."

text.content: The name Chen Nian struck Chen Ji's heart like a sudden pang, yet his expression remained unnervingly composed. In his mind flashed the words of Mo Xiansheng—Chen Nian was the key to Heavenly Fate, and her existence would disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight. This meant he could not use the Tianji Record to ascertain Chen Tiaming and Chen Nian's precise locations.

dialogue.content: "Your sister was taken by the Holy Sect ten years ago." Chen Ming's voice carried a meaningful tone. "The reason Chen Tiaming appeared in the Northern Frontier is precisely for her. As for the details—" he deliberately paused, "if you want to know, after we cooperate, I will tell you gradually."

text.content: Just then, hurried footsteps broke the eerie atmosphere in the courtyard. A black-armored guard rushed in, kneeling on one knee, his voice carrying barely concealed panic: "Report—! His Highness the Crown Prince urgently summons! The Northern Frontier border town has been attacked by demonic path forces! The enemy commander claims to be Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie! The border garrison has already lost three military camps!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Han Lie—this name he knew too well—the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect among the three major sects, possessing逆天 combat power but with a simple mind. It was him who had been outmaneuvered by Chen Ji in several conflicts, yet never willing to accept defeat. Now he had actually led demonic path forces to invade the dynasty's border?

text.content: Chen Ming looked at Chen Ji, saying meaningfully: "It seems your Crown Prince will summon you very soon." His voice carried a hint of schadenfreude. "Han Lie comes aggressively. The generals in the dynasty capable of resisting him are few. And you—Crown Prince's Grand Tutor—are his most trusted strategist."

Chen Ming's words were like a basin of cold water pouring down, allowing Chen Ji to instantly see the predicament before him. If he led the army in the capacity of Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, he would inevitably have to demonstrate sufficient strength to convince the troops—this meant his painstakingly constructed worthless persona would completely collapse. But if he refused, the Crown Prince's trust...

dialogue.content: "Think it through carefully." Chen Ming replaced his veil, his voice emerging from behind it. "As long as you maintain the first two conditions of our agreement, I will provide you with intelligence gradually. As for the third condition—" his figure had already merged into the night, "you will change your mind."

text.content: As the voice faded, only Chen Ji remained in the courtyard. The autumn wind passed, carrying a bone-penetrating chill. His fists slowly tightened within his sleeves, his knuckles turning white from the force. Han Lie, Chen Tiaming, Chen Nian—these names tangled together like a mess of hemp, making the situation grow even more complex.

dialogue.content: Inside the Crown Prince's residence, candlelight flickered. When Chen Ji entered the Council Hall, the Crown Prince was already anxiously pacing. Upon seeing Chen Ji enter, the Crown Prince rushed forward, his voice urgent: "Mr. Chen! You've seen the Northern Frontier emergency report? That scoundrel Han Lie actually dares collude with the demonic path and invade our territory!"

choice.prompt: Faced with the Crown Prince's summons and expedition request, Chen Ji needed to make a decision.

choices.text: Accept the expedition, retreating to advance
choices.description: Agree to lead the army, but devise ways to delay or create incidents along the route, maintaining the persona while gaining military authority.
choices.visible_reward: Control military authority, can investigate Chen Tiaming's movements through this opportunity
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may see through the disguise

text.content: Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his voice calm: "Your Highness, rest assured. This subject is willing to go to the Northern Frontier." He raised his head, a gleam of light flashing in his eyes. "However, this subject has one request—please grant this subject discretionary authority. Border situations are complex, and there may be occasions requiring flexible response."

choices.text: Decline the expedition and recommend someone else
choices.description: Refuse on grounds of physical illness or other important matters, recommending other generals trusted by the Crown Prince.
choices.visible_cost: Loses some of the Crown Prince's trust
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low profile and continue arranging secretly
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may become suspicious

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his voice carrying a hint of helplessness: "Your Highness, please forgive me. This subject has had a recurrence of an old illness recently and truly cannot endure a long journey. However—" he took out a Jade Slip from his sleeve, "although this subject cannot go personally, I can analyze enemy intelligence for Your Highness and formulate strategies."

choices.description: Not directly agree or refuse, but instead propose conditions to test the Crown Prince's bottom line while striving for more leverage.
choices.visible_reward: Probe the Crown Prince's attitude, obtain practical benefits
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may feel coerced

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke: "Your Highness, please hear me out. Han Lie's combat power is extraordinary, no ordinary general can withstand him. Though I am willing to go, if it is merely throwing an egg against a rock, losing soldiers and suffering defeats is minor, but delaying Your Highness's great cause is major." His gaze fixed directly on the Crown Prince, "May I ask how many troops Your Highness can grant me?"

The Crown Prince fell silent, his brow furrowed tightly. He was all too aware of the risks of sending Chen Ji to battle—this Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, though full of stratagems, possessed truly mediocre cultivation. What if something went wrong? But among the court generals who could be deployed, either they had faced Han Lie and suffered crushing defeat, or they were simply useless in battle.

dialogue.content: Just then, an uproar arose from outside the hall. As the Crown Prince was about to fly into a rage, a guard hurried in to report: "Your Highness! Someone outside the palace seeks an audience with Master Chen, and the visitor calls themselves... the Demonic Path Saint Maiden Ye Qing!" The Crown Prince's face instantly turned ashen—the Demonic Path Saint Maiden? That was a core figure of the Demonic Holy Sect!

text.content: A flicker of understanding crossed Chen Ji's eyes. Ye Qing's arrival was perfectly timed—she had said her Demonic Path miasma could conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. This move was one he had arranged long ago. Only he hadn't expected her to appear at this precise moment. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly—everything was under control.

dialogue.content: The hall doors swung open as a graceful figure glided in. Ye Qing, draped in a black dress, her features exquisite as a painting, her lips curved with an enigmatic smile. Her gaze swept past the Crown Prince and fixed directly on Chen Ji, her voice cold yet edged with mockery: "Young Master Chen, it's been a while. I have a way to keep you from the campaign while giving you a proper excuse to remain in the capital."

text.content: The Crown Prince watched this scene with mounting suspicion—could the Demonic Path Saint Maiden and his Crown Prince's Grand Tutor actually be acquainted? Yet Chen Ji remained composed, as if everything unfolded according to plan. He clasped his hands behind his back and spoke calmly: "Miss Ye, if you have a superior idea, please voice it directly." Ye Qing let out a light laugh: "Han Lie's invasion of the border is merely a stratagem to lure out the prey. And that prey—" she turned her eyes to Chen Ji, "—is you."

Ye Qing's words struck like sudden thunder within the council hall. The Crown Prince whipped toward Chen Ji, suspicion blazing in his eyes. Chen Ji, however, maintained his unruffled demeanor, listening as though the matter held no relevance to him. He mused to himself: Ye Qing clearly possesses knowledge far beyond what she lets on. Han Lie's invasion is directed at him—this intelligence, what is its true worth?

dialogue.content: "Do you wish to understand why Han Lie targets you specifically?" Ye Qing drew near to Chen Ji, her voice dropping to barely a whisper. "Because his objective has nothing to do with border towns. What he truly seeks is the Tianji Record Fragment in your sleeve." Her gaze settled upon him with a calculating assessment, "And the forces backing him prove far more formidable than you can fathom."

text.content: A subtle sharpness flickered across Chen Ji's eyes. Han Lie's targeting of the Tianji Record—that came as an unexpected revelation. He had assumed Han Lie bore a grudge merely from being repeatedly outmaneuvered, yet a deeper layer of complexity lay beneath. "If you march out now, you'll play directly into their hands," Ye Qing continued. "But if you refuse—" her gaze shifted toward the Crown Prince, "—this prince here will hardly let matters rest."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposes a method allowing Chen Ji to avoid the campaign while remaining. How should one respond?

choices.description: First listen to Ye Qing's specific plan, while observing the Crown Prince's reactions, searching for weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: The plan may harbor hidden dangers

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's lips curved into a knowing smile, her voice tinged with confidence: "Quite straightforward. Under my title as the Demonic Path Saint Maiden, I'll deliver a formal petition to the dynasty demanding peace talks. The negotiation site shall be none other than the capital. When the time comes, you, as the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, will naturally stay behind to participate in the negotiations."

choices.text: First inquire who stands behind Han Lie
choices.description: Ye Qing says the forces standing behind Han Lie are even more terrifying—this intelligence is more valuable than an escape plan
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may seize the opportunity to demand a price

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt Ye Qing, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority: 'Who stands behind Han Lie?' Ye Qing's smile faltered slightly, as if she hadn't expected Chen Ji to be so direct. She hesitated briefly, then lowered her voice: 'The former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan. He has been secretly colluding with Han Lie for a long time.'"

choices.description: "The words of the Demonic Path Saint cannot be fully trusted; make a statement before the Crown Prince, maintaining surface-level distance with Ye Qing."

text.content: "Chen Ji took a step back, his voice cold: 'Miss Ye, this is the Crown Prince's Council Hall, not the backyard of your Demonic Holy Sect. I cannot accept your proposal.' His gaze turned to the Crown Prince, and he bowed respectfully, 'Your Highness, I believe that with Han Lie's invasion, we should dispatch a great army to punish him, to demonstrate our nation's might.'"

"Ling Yuan. The former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's mind rapidly flashed through information about this person—ostensibly protective of Chen Ji but harboring malicious intentions, the previous generation's candidate for inheritance, passed over by the Tianji Record and thus filled with resentment. This name hung like a sword above his head, ready to fall at any moment."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing seemed to read through Chen Ji's thoughts, letting out a light laugh: 'I see you also know of Ling Yuan's厉害. He has long coveted the Tianji Record, and Han Lie is merely his pawn. And your dear Senior Brother Chen Tiangming—' Her gaze turned meaningful. 'He may not be the person you think he is.'"

text.content: "The Crown Prince finally came back to his senses, watching the back-and-forth between Chen Ji and Ye Qing, his brow furrowed even tighter. He interrupted the two, his voice carrying a hint of displeasure: 'Mr. Chen, what exactly is going on? What relationship do you have with the Demonic Path Saint?' Upon hearing this, the corner of Ye Qing's lips curved into an even wider smile."

"Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his expression calm. He knew this was the most critical moment. The Crown Prince had already begun to suspect him—if he didn't handle this properly, the trust he had painstakingly built would be destroyed. He had to find a balance between Ye Qing and the Crown Prince, neither offending Ye Qing nor losing the Crown Prince's trust."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji smiled faintly, his voicecalm而composed: 'Your Highness, please allow me to explain. Although this woman is from the Demonic Path, she and I have crossed paths once before. Her visit today must surely be regarding the matter of Han Lie.' He turned to Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a hint of warning, 'Miss Ye, if you have something to say, why not speak directly instead of beating around the bush?'"

text.content: "Ye Qing's smile froze on her lips for an instant, then turned into a sigh: 'Young Master Chen is indeed cautious.' Her voice suddenly became serious. 'I came today indeed to deliver a piece of news. Within Han Lie's army, there is a hidden force from our Holy Sect. If Young Master Chen is willing, I can have them turn against him at a crucial moment.'"

dialogue.content: "At these words, the Crown Prince's eyes immediately lit up. If someone within the Demonic Path was willing to turn traitor, this war would become much easier! But Chen Ji remained unmoved—he knew Ye Qing too well. This woman never made a losing trade. For her to reveal this information, she must have ulterior motives."

text.content: "Ye Qing seemed to have anticipated Chen Ji's reaction. She stepped forward, her voice extremely low: 'My condition is simple—after Han Lie's defeat, the Tianji Record Fragment in his possession belongs to me.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. Han Lie has a Tianji Record Fragment? This intelligence, he had never known."

"A诡异 silence fell over the Council Hall. The Crown Prince looked at Chen Ji, then at Ye Qing, unable to make a decision for the moment. Chen Ji, however, fell into deep contemplation—the news that Han Lie had a Tianji Record Fragment was invaluable. If true, then Ling Yuan's ambitions were far greater than he had imagined."

dialogue.content: "After a moment of deliberation, Chen Ji finally spoke: 'Miss Ye's intelligence, I will暂时记下. But regarding the Fragment, I need to verify it.' His gaze locked onto Ye Qing. 'If Han Lie truly possesses a Tianji Record Fragment, I agree to cooperate with you after the matter is settled.' A flicker of triumph appeared in Ye Qing's eyes: 'Deal.'"

text.content: "The Crown Prince listened in a daze, but seeing the two reach an agreement, a stone in his heart also landed. He cleared his throat: 'Since that's the case, what does Mr. Chen think we should do at present?' Chen Ji turned to face the Crown Prince and bowed: 'Your Highness, I believe the priority is to send someone to ascertain Han Lie's strength. We must not act rashly.'"

"Before the Crown Prince could respond,急促的脚步声 rang out from outside the hall. A scout stumbled in, his voice filled with terror: 'Report—! Han Lie's army has suddenly changed direction, heading... heading straight for the capital at rapid speed! The vanguard has already arrived three hundred li outside!' The Crown Prince's face instantly turned pale."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji's gaze suddenly hardened. Han Lie changing the army's direction to charge directly at the capital—this wasn't about seizing territory, this was about taking lives! His mind quickly flashed through various possibilities, finally settling on one thought—What Ling Yuan wanted was not some border city, it was the throne itself!"

text.content: "Ye Qing's expression also turned grave. Shewhispered说道: 'It seems Ling Yuan is more impatient than I thought. He has Han Lie march directly on the capital. Once successful, the structure of the Three Great Sects will completely change.' Her gaze fell on Chen Ji. 'Our agreement may need to be executed early.'"

"The Crown Prince was already pacing anxiously, his voice trembling: 'Mr. Chen! What should we do? The capital's garrison is only ten thousand strong. How can it resist Han Lie's iron cavalry?' Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. The situation had slipped beyond his control, but the more critical the moment, the more he couldn't lose his composure."

dialogue.content: "'Please remain calm, Your Highness.' Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, yet carried a stabilizing, reassuring power. 'Han Lie's isolated army has penetrated deep—his reinforcements will certainly be lacking. As long as we hold the capital for three to five days, relief forces from all directions will arrive. Then, with internal and external coordination, Han Lie will surely be defeated.' He paused. 'But at present, Your Highness needs someone who can stabilize the overall situation.'"

"Ye Qing suddenly interjected: 'I do have a method.' Her gaze swept across the Crown Prince and Chen Ji. 'Han Lie's action this time, Ling Yuan must be coordinating in the shadows. If we can expose Ling Yuan's identity, we can unite with other forces within the Three Great Sects for a joint campaign.' A cold smile curved her lips. 'My Demonic Holy Sect is not Ling Yuan's backyard.'"

text.content: "This proposal made Chen Ji's eyes light up. Expose Ling Yuan's identity—this truly was the best strategy to break the current impasse. But the question was, how to make Ling Yuan show his true colors? He deliberated for a moment, when suddenly an idea flashed through his mind—Chen Tiangming. If Chen Tiangming truly possessed a Tianji Record Fragment, then Ling Yuan would surely make a move."

Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sweeping between Ye Qing and the Crown Prince before settling on the prince. "Your Highness, I have a plan that may turn the tide. But it requires Your Highness's cooperation, and... a little time." His voice was low and resolute. "Give me three days. Within three days, I will expose Ling Yuan's true colors."

The Crown Prince gazed at Chen Ji's unwavering eyes, his inner turmoil gradually settling. He took a deep breath and nodded emphatically: "Fine! I'll give you three days! Within these three days, whatever you need, I will fully cooperate!" Ye Qing watched this scene from the side, a hint of playful smile flickering at the corner of his mouth—this man indeed never fought a battle without preparation.

Night deepened, and the capital's lights swayed in the wind. Chen Ji stood alone on the high platform of the Crown Prince's residence, gazing toward the dark northern horizon. Three days, only three days. He must accomplish an almost impossible task within these three days—expose Ling Yuan while preserving his position in the capital, and find news of Chen Tianming and Chen Nian...

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a warning: "Boy, the prophecy on the fourth page of the Tianji Record has become blurred. This means someone is interfering with the Heavenly Secrets." Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When the scales of fate began to tilt, the only thing he could rely on was his own wisdom and planning.

text.content: "Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji murmured this name softly, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. Since you want to play, then I will play along to the end. He turned and descended the platform, disappearing into the night. In some dark corner of the capital, a pair of eyes intently watched Chen Ji's retreating figure—it was the hidden棋子 Chen Ming had left behind.

Meanwhile, outside the northern border city, Han Lie rode on a black demonic beast, gazing toward the southern capital, a bloodthirsty smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "Chen Ji, this time I want to see where else you can run." The war blade in his hand gleamed coldly under the moonlight, "The Tianji Record will be mine!"

In a more distant northern realm, in a secret valley, Chen Tianming stood before an ancient altar, gazing at the sleeping maiden on the altar, his eyes filled with complex emotions. "Nian Nian, wait a bit longer." His voice was low and gentle, "When Uncle gets the Tianji Record, he can save you." The maiden's face bore a striking resemblance to Chen Ji—it was Chen Nian, missing for ten years.

The night was as dark as ink, and the capital's crisis was imminent. Han Lie's army was like a hungry wild wolf, closing in on the capital. Within the capital, Chen Ji's alliance with the Crown Prince, his deal with Ye Qing, his pact with Chen Ming—all the clues intertwined, forming an intricate and bewildering web. The three-day deadline hung in the balance, victory undecided. And Chen Ji had already prepared himself to welcome the coming storm.
